imf_fsi.name: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (balance sheet and income items)
imf_fsi.note: The IMF publishes the underlying balance-sheet and income items; the ratios here are Geo Desk's division of them using the IMF's FSI definitions. The World Bank's bank indicators come from this same IMF dataset, a year or more later.

formula.t1: Tier 1 capital less deductions ÷ risk-weighted assets
formula.roa: annualised net income before tax ÷ average total assets
formula.npl: non-performing loans ÷ loans after specific provisions (a little above the official ratio, whose denominator is gross loans: the gross amount is not published)

imf_cpi.name: IMF Consumer Price Index (headline, annual % change)
imf_cpi.basis: national statistical office data, as sent to the IMF
imf_cpi.note: The World Bank's inflation series is also compiled from IMF and national sources, so this is a check on dating and rounding, not a wholly separate measurement.

imf_er.name: IMF Exchange Rates (national currency per US$, period average)
imf_er.note: The World Bank's official exchange rate is also an IMF-based series, so agreement here is expected.

imf_eer.name: IMF Effective Exchange Rates (index, 2010 = 100)
imf_eer.basis: trade-weighted index against all partners: nominal, and real (consumer-price-adjusted) where published
imf_eer.note: For the UAE the IMF publishes the nominal index only; it holds no real index for it.

bis_eer.name: BIS Effective Exchange Rates (broad basket of 64 economies, 2020 = 100)
bis_eer.note: The BIS computes its own weights and price deflators, so its nominal index can differ from the IMF's; the real index is the one neither the World Bank nor the IMF holds for the UAE.

bis_cbpol.name: BIS Central bank policy rates
bis_cbpol.basis: official policy rate, end of month, as reported by each central bank
bis_cbpol.note: Covers about forty central banks; the Central Bank of the UAE is not among them.

unavailable.name: IMF International Reserves and Foreign Currency Liquidity (IRFCL)
unavailable.reason: The IMF holds no series for the UAE (the UAE does not publish the template), so reserves stay with the World Bank's figure alone.

unavailable.name: IMF Monetary and Financial Statistics: interest rates (MFS_IR)
unavailable.reason: The query for the UAE returned no series, so lending, deposit and policy rates are not connected.

unavailable.name: BIS central bank policy rates and credit to the private non-financial sector
unavailable.reason: The BIS holds no UAE series for either: its policy-rate table covers about forty central banks and its credit table about forty-five economies, and the UAE is in neither.

unavailable.name: IMF real effective exchange rate
unavailable.reason: The IMF publishes a real index for most countries but only a nominal one for the UAE. The BIS real index above is the only real effective rate we found for the UAE.

unavailable.name: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators, published ratios (core set)
unavailable.reason: The IMF's open API exposes the balance-sheet items but not the finished ratios, so the ratios shown are derived by dividing those items; the non-performing-loan ratio uses a net denominator and runs slightly above the official one.

unavailable.name: Central Bank of the UAE statistical bulletin
unavailable.reason: Not attempted: published as PDF and Excel bulletins with no open API, so it is not read by script.
